categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, sales, and after-sales services of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) systems, focusing on large fixed-wing, long-endurance UAVs under the Wing Loong series. It also provides UAV technology services including flight operations for weather modification, meteorological detection, and emergency rescue. The business model integrates market development, product R&D, supply chain management, production, delivery, and customer service.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses advanced core technologies in large fixed-wing long-endurance UAV platform design, intelligent autonomous flight control, integrated manufacturing, and system testing. Key innovations include modular design, integrated control systems, composite material structures, anti-icing technology, TSN network communication, and rapid payload integration. Production employs lean manufacturing with intelligent flexible production lines supporting multi-model UAV assembly, backed by comprehensive testing and flight verification systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic military and government agencies, international military clients across more than ten countries, and civil sectors such as emergency management, meteorology, and public safety. The company serves both domestic and international markets with a focus on military UAV exports and expanding civil UAV applications in weather modification, emergency rescue, and industrial uses.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in China, with manufacturing and R&D facilities in Chengdu and the self-contained UAV industrial base in Zigong. The company exports UAV systems to over ten countries globally, establishing a dual domestic and international market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as a midstream to downstream integrator and manufacturer in the UAV supply chain, focusing on system integration, assembly, testing, and delivery. It manages a robust and agile supply chain ecosystem, including strategic supplier partnerships and in-house production capabilities to support large-scale UAV manufacturing and rapid delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing UAV intelligent autonomy, modular and agile design, multi-platform integration, and expanding UAV applications in military and civil domains. The company emphasizes innovation in AI, swarm technology, autonomous decision-making, and low-cost manufacturing. It invests heavily in R&D, with a 39.12% R&D-to-revenue ratio in 2024, focusing on new UAV models, enhanced payload capabilities, and system-level integration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of UAV systems and related services, including technology services and after-sales support. The company employs a direct sales model targeting military and civil customers, supplemented by service contracts for flight operations and maintenance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic UAV system integrator and manufacturer, recognized as a national champion in large fixed-wing long-endurance UAVs. It competes in the global military UAV market, particularly in the medium-altitude long-endurance segment, and is expanding into civil UAV markets. Its main competitive advantages lie in comprehensive system capabilities, technological innovation, and strong government and military backing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 685 million, a 74.28% decrease from the previous year, primarily due to market demand fluctuations and delayed customer procurement. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 53.9 million, reflecting a significant decline. Total assets increased by 18.56% to RMB 8.73 billion, supported by increased inventory investments. The company maintains a strong asset base and continues to invest heavily in R&D despite short-term profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a full-spectrum UAV product line covering 10 kg to 6-ton classes, with advanced autonomous control, modular payload integration, and multi-mission capabilities. Its Wing Loong series UAVs provide precise reconnaissance and strike functions, validated by extensive domestic and international operational experience. The company emphasizes integrated system solutions, rapid innovation, and comprehensive lifecycle support to deliver high reliability, flexibility, and operational effectiveness to military and civil customers.
